bigIdea: The library reaches the one in three it has missed when it goes where people already are.

beats.name: What Is
beats.claim: One in three adults here has never held a library card, because we waited for them to come.

beats.name: What Could Be
beats.claim: Twelve laundromats issued 2,400 new cards in six months.

beats.name: Return
beats.claim: Going to people costs a quarter as much and reaches the people we missed.

beats.name: Bridge
beats.claim: Two hundred sites take three steps and 4% of the budget.

beats.name: Commit
beats.claim: Fund 200 outreach sites in January's budget vote.
